hooks.command: [ -n "$DOLT_CREDS_JWK" ] && command -v dolt >/dev/null && printf '%s' "$DOLT_CREDS_JWK" | dolt creds import >/dev/null && dolt creds use "$DOLT_CREDS_KEY_ID" ; command -v bd >/dev/null && [ -f .beads/metadata.json ] && [ ! -d .beads/embeddeddolt ] && bd bootstrap --yes >/dev/null 2>&1; git config beads.role >/dev/null || git config beads.role maintainer; exit 0
